skill.summary: Generate beautiful charts by paying per request with x402 micropayments (USDC on Base) instead of an API key. Use when the user wants a chart and has no CHAR...

latestVersion.changelog:
- The bundled script (scripts/pay-and-fetch.js) and package.json were removed; usage is now fully CLI-oriented.
- CLI has been renamed to chartsplat-x402-cli, invoked via npx (no install needed).
- Documentation updates: revised usage instructions, flags, and examples to reflect the CLI-based workflow.
- Candlestick/OHLC usage clarified—now requires a JSON config passed to the CLI.
- Error handling instructions updated to match CLI experience.
- Metadata updated for the new CLI package and version.
